text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To become someone who can run freely.
Mejiro Palmer, seeking to be reborn.
The day of her grand debut had arrived.
choice_data_list: It's finally time for the Make Debut race.
It's finally time for the Make Debut race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll try to run as true to myself as I can.
To the best of my ability, at least.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And then, debut as a party girl☆
Totally!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, good luck over there too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what!? You're gonna pull a full party-animal move
right out the gate for your Make Debut?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayy, well obvs☆
Hype up the vibes from the start and etch proof that you were alive, ya know!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: From here on out, I gotta show 'em Palmer-chan's running the floor☆ Vrooom-vroooom♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I-I see. Like a fresh high school debut, maybe it's better to show off right off the bat.
choice_data_list: There aren't many spectators yet, so it's easier to let loose.
There aren't many spectators yet, so it's easier to let loose, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Got it, Trainer.
Let's head right over to the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Palmer, I have come to check in on you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: McQueen and Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Good luck. No other members
of the Mejiro family are here today, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But there are tons of other people in the venue
cheering for Palmer, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh, someone who cheers for me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer...! Look at that banner...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the fence surrounding the paddock, a banner reading
'Go for it, Mejiro Family!' was hung,
with a dozen or so people gathered around it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see, fans of the Mejiro family!
Long-time fans who have supported
everyone in the Mejiro family for years.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I've seen them around before too.
Back then, I got so worked up trying not to let them down.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, I appreciate it, but the bar might've just gotten way higher!
Partying in front of those people, huh...
choice_data_list: Palmer, say hello to everyone at the venue.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, everyone!
I-I will be making my debut tod—no, wait~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm Palmer♪ Mejiro Palmer~♪
I'm gonna run now, yo, yo-yo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Gonna pull off an explosive breakaway, scurry up the slope, check it..."

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Mmm...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
N-No, umm...
I look forward... to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An impromptu rap drowned out by the stirred murmurs of the crowd.
Even so, the party-girl-in-the-making broke only her legs out of the shell and began to run.
